source.query:
select * from dscc.wave2_customer_inventory_d 
where stock_date >= add_months(trunc(current_date(),'MM'), -1)
and stock_date <= from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(current_date(), 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')

sink.preCopyScript:
delete [NESZ_STG].[Customer_Inventory_D]
where stock_date >= CONVERT(varchar(7), dateadd(mm,-1,getdate()) , 120) + '-01' 
and Stock_Date <=convert(varchar(10),getdate(),120)

delete [NESZ_STG].[Customer_Inventory_D]
where stock_date >= CONVERT(varchar(7), dateadd(mm,-1,DATEADD(HOUR, 8, getdate())) , 120) + '-01' 
and Stock_Date <=convert(varchar(10),DATEADD(HOUR, 8, getdate()),120)
